# B.I Music

> B.I Music is a free music streaming web application for Afrobeats, Hip-Hop, R&B, and Amapiano.

## Main Features
- [Home](https://djsky577-maker.github.io/BIMusic2): Discover trending songs and artists.
- [Search](https://djsky577-maker.github.io/BIMusic2/?tab=search): Find any song or artist.
- [Library](https://djsky577-maker.github.io/BIMusic2/?tab=library): Your followed artists and favorites.
